principle_violations.reason: The current implementation of the volume method in Shape-implementing classes throws an UnsupportedOperationException for shapes that don't have a volume, leading to violations when the Shape interface is extended with new shapes.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibility of volume computation into a new VolumetricShape interface. Only shapes with volumes should implement this new interface.

principle_violations.reason: The Shape interface enforces all implementers to define a volume method, even for non-volumetric shapes, which breaches the principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create an additional interface, VolumetricShape, that contains the volume method. Only volumetric shapes should implement this interface.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
